main_body: A brown blocky, irregular shape of mostly flat brown fill with a black outline: a left square block and a taller central block, with a tan lump at the lower right. It reads as a rough synthetic block or stack of boxes, not a clear piece of furniture.
top_band: none; the central column from row 1 starts with a thin tan 1-2px highlight at the top (rows 1-2), then the same brown continues down as one flat face
evidence: Reading a column through the middle of the tall central block: a tiny tan highlight at the top (about 1 row), then flat brown for around 20 rows down to the base. No distinct lighter top band, no front-edge line, no eave shadow, no inset details. The left block likewise has a flat brown face with only 1-row tan flecks. The tan lump at the lower right is a flat patch with no top and front distinction. This is a front elevation with no horizontal surface visible from above.

style.evidence: The candidate is mostly one brown tone plus a tan accent, about 2-3 steps, against about 6 in the references. The outline is a uniform near-black line around each shape (sticker look). Large brown areas are flat fills with only a few stray tan pixels as texture. The tiles carry about 2-4 colours, far below the references' roughly 10 per tile. It would look much thinner and flatter next to the stall and well.
